diagnosis: The worker renders custom business metrics and dispatches them to destination_email without checking if the report belongs to the requester's organization. An attacker can enqueue internal analytics reports of rival companies to be emailed directly to their external email address.

corrected_code:
class DeliverAnalyticsReportWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(report_id, destination_email)
    report = CustomReport.find(report_id)
    raise 'Unauthorized recipient' unless report.organization.users.exists?(email: destination_email)

    AnalyticsMailer.send_digest(report, destination_email).deliver_now
  end
end

class ReportsController < ApplicationController
  def schedule_email
    report = current_organization.custom_reports.find(params[:id])
    DeliverAnalyticsReportWorker.perform_async(report.id, current_user.email)
    render json: { message: 'Report scheduled' }
  end
end
